notes.title: First Demo Update + Little Announcement
notes.content:
Frankendice Demo Patch Notes - v.0.2.5
Thank you all for playing the demo and the wishlists so far! We are releasing the first update for the Frankendice Demo and have a little announcement at the end of the patch notes.

Additionally we are participating in the Games Baked in Germany event that just started with other awesome games developed in Germany!

New
 New Settings System with rebindable keybindings
 New interactive tutorial in the main menu

Changes
 All level are now playable from the beginning via the level selection screen
 Updated the level selection screen 
 Updated the demo completion screen

Bug Fixes
 User Settings are now loaded properly
 Dice can no longer get stuck in a moveable dice
 HUD Animation plays properly now
 Spawning of dice doesn't count towards the times rolled anymore

We have added a forum for Feedback & Suggestions and Bug Reports, where you can post your feedback for the demo and report any encountered bugs so we can fix them.

Check out our updated Demo of Frankendice an let us know what you think - don't forget to wishlist as well!

Now for the little announcement we've mentioned in the beginning:

We will be attending the DoKomi 2024 in Dusseldorf from 28.06 - 30.06. You can find us in the Creative Games Area where you can play the newest version of our Frankendice Demo!
